name: Hanamaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hanamaki city emblem in blue and orange: four blue petal-like swirls around an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Hanamaki, a city in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 2006.

features.role: Hanamaki city emblem — four blue petal-like swirls around an orange disc
